# Data and citation

## Site data

The data come from the FLUXNET data hub (snapshot `fluxnet_shuttle_snapshot_20261113T105747.csv`). The data citations for the five sites are:

```{r citations, results = 'asis', echo = FALSE}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(site_metadata))) {
  cat("- **", site_metadata$site_id[i], "** (", site_metadata$name[i], "): ",
      site_metadata$citation[i], "\n", sep = "")
}
```

## FLUXNET data product
 Pastorello et al. (2020), Scientific Data 7, 225, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-020-0534-3, and the FLUX

## Acknowledgment

FLUXNET data products were produced and harmonized by eddy covariance regional networks and data processing centers, including AmeriFlux, ChinaFlux, European Fluxes Database, ICOS, JapanFlux, KoFlux, OzFlux, SAEON, and TERN. These products also include a modified version of ERA5 hourly data provided by the Copernicus Climate Change Service.
